question: Does a low-degree-of-freedom, survivorship-aware time-series momentum sleeve on the historical Binance USD-M perpetual universe provide positive funding-aware economics and diversification/crisis-alpha evidence versus BRRK?

universe.source: TSMOM-DATA-0027 + TSMOM-DATA-0028 historical Binance USD-M USDT perpetual archive
universe.daily_eligibility: 240 contiguous completed daily bars and completed-day quote volume >= $25m
universe.lag: eligibility observed at UTC day t may affect positions no earlier than t+1
universe.survivorship_rule: preserve later-ended contracts on historical dates; never substitute current survivors

signal.type: time-series momentum only; no cross-sectional rank
signal.trend_function: exact existing project trend_score on each contract price
signal.signal_strength: direction only; magnitude of trend_score does not size positions

risk_normalization.volatility_estimator: 30 completed daily log-return observations, annualized sqrt(365)
risk_normalization.weighting: inverse realized volatility across every eligible contract with valid signal/volatility
risk_normalization.portfolio_normalization: sum(abs(target_weights)) = 1.0 whenever at least one contract is active
risk_normalization.net_exposure: unconstrained; emerges from time-series signal signs

execution.held_return: target from t applied to t+1 price return

funding.source: official Binance Public Data USD-M monthly fundingRate archives
funding.sign_convention: portfolio funding return per event = - held_weight * funding_rate; positive-rate longs pay and positive-rate shorts receive
funding.event_timing: daily target becomes effective at 00:00:01 UTC on t+1; the 00:00 funding event uses the previously held target while later funding events use the new target
funding.requirement: canonical result must report native historical funding; price-only result is diagnostic only

benchmarks.strict_router_BRRK: ROUTER-PNL-0005 BTC-spot strict-router equity where overlap is available

required_outputs: full-history and BRRK-overlap price-only and funding-aware CAGR/MDD/annualized volatility/Sharpe/Calmar
long gross, short gross, net exposure, active-contract count and maximum single-name weight
funding contribution split between long and short positions
daily and monthly return correlation versus BRRK on common history
TSMOM return on BRRK worst decile days and worst decile months
evidence that later-ended contracts participate only while point-in-time eligible

qualification_rule.funding_aware_economics: canonical 5 bps funding-aware CAGR > 0 and Sharpe > 0
qualification_rule.crisis_alpha: mean TSMOM return on BRRK worst 10% daily returns >= 0
qualification_rule.decision: all three are required to authorize a separately preregistered portfolio-stack experiment; failure does not authorize parameter tuning

prohibited: no Top-K or rolling-Sharpe asset selection
no long/short side rebalance to force dollar neutrality
no same-window rescue tuning after the first valid run
stopping_rule: Freeze the first valid result. If qualification fails, retain as rejected evidence and move to carry rather than tuning TSMOM on the same sample. If it passes, only a separately preregistered fixed-weight/risk-budget portfolio-stack test may combine it with BRRK.
